title: U.S. Army Special Forces Order of Battle, Vietnam Theater (1957–1975)
citation: Stephen Sherman, U.S. Army Special Forces Order of Battle Vietnam Theater (1957-1975), RADIX Press, 1995. Part 1 of 3, 118 pp (item 4030205001); Part 2 of 3, 134 pp (item 4030205002). Chuck Carlock Collection, association Rattler/Firebird Association, Vietnam Center and Sam Johnson Vietnam Archive, Texas Tech University. Copyright-restricted; accessed through the Vietnam Reading Room portal.
notes: A compiled reference listing every U.S. Special Forces camp in South Vietnam by name, controlling C-detachment, A-detachment number, grid coordinate, province, and final disposition, and — in Part 2 — a per-camp roster of detachment commanders and team sergeants with dates. Part 1's master table reads 'Nui Ba Den  3  324  XT28105820  Tay Ninh  Closed'; Part 2's entry reads 'Nui Ba Den 324, Tay Ninh Province/Phu Khuong District, XT281582, MISSION: RADIO RELAY', with a note that a major of B-220 was given the mission to set up the radio relay site, and a commander roster running from July 1964. Part 1 also records that the Xuan Loc camp, Det A-353, was 'Relocated to Nui Ba Den'. A narrow right-hand column of personal names in Part 1 is clipped and interleaved in the scan's text layer, so no name in that column can be attributed to a particular camp without consulting the page image; Part 2's rosters are laid out clearly and are safe to read.
